description: Update properties for an existing tag. Only the fields provided are changed; at least one field must be provided.

archived.description: If set, determines whether this tag is archived. Archived tags are not displayed in relevant areas of the Lunch Money app.

archived_at.description: Archived timestamp for the tag, as an ISO 8601 extended datetime (e.g. 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z). Pass null to clear it. On a tag that is not archived yet, archived must also be set to true.

background_color.description: New background color of the tag. Pass null to clear it.

description.description: New description of the tag. Up to 200 characters. Pass null to clear it.

name.description: New name of the tag. 1-100 characters.

tagId.description: Id of the tag to update.

text_color.description: New text color of the tag. Pass null to clear it.

name: update_tag
